note: LIVING DOCUMENT (owner 2026-11-24: every PDF teaches the pipeline). Laws are seeded from owner directives; each GOD run may APPEND evidence-backed amendments to 'learned' (never silent edits, never deletions). god_extract.py falls back to the seed values below if this file is missing/corrupt, so a law can never silently disappear.

marks_allowed.source: owner directive 2026-11-24 (god pipeline task list item 3: 'Add marks-QC law {2,7,10} to god pipeline')
marks_allowed.semantics: per-question printed marks on AKTU B.Tech papers: 2 = Section A short-answer format, 7 = Section B/C long-answer format, 10 = long-format papers (2 x 10 = 20 style).
marks_allowed.on_violation: row annotated verify=+marks-off-law in god6_questions; violation {label, marks} recorded in the god6_audit diff; extracted value is KEPT (never silently rewritten or dropped); 3+ identical off-law values across one run => propose a codex amendment in audit notes for owner review

marks_null.source: supabase_schema.sql DESIGN NOTES: marks NULL = not printed/inferable on the paper - HONEST, not missing
marks_null.on_violation: never flagged as defect; null_rate reported per paper in the audit diff so a rising NULL rate is visible instead of invisible

learned.lesson: BCS301 2024-25 (ea84defe) prints zero-padded marks arithmetic ('2 x 07 = 14', '07 x 3 = 21', '07 x 1 = 07') - section headers carry the marks signal; per-question marks may be absent (-> honest NULL) while section total arithmetic pins {2,7}. Gemini Hydrogen single-call output on the same paper: marks 2/7 on all 22 rows, zero hallucinated marks.

RESOLUTION HIJACK: the code+year glob returned sorted(cands)[0] over the 11k-PDF runner corpus and silently transcribed the WRONG paper (bcs301-2024-25 row -> mar-2024 PDF), hash_ok=False recorded but 9 AI sends still burned. FIXED as law: glob candidates are sha256-verified before acceptance (resolve_paper) and a wrong hash now HARD-FAILS verdict=hash-mismatch with 0 AI calls (wrong-paper gate). Run 10: 10/10 papers hash_ok=True, zero wrong-paper rows.
learned.evidence: god-evidence branch shard verdicts run 9 vs run 10

learned.lesson: SECTION-TOTAL MARKS LEAK: models transcribe section-total arithmetic lines as question marks (labels 1/2 carrying marks 20/30 = '2 x 10 = 20' style headers; also a stray 5). Marks law {2,7,10} caught all 6 on 4 papers and flagged +marks-off-law with values KEPT. AMENDMENT PROPOSAL (owner review needed): deterministic demotion to honest NULL when marks not in law AND the label is a section-total instruction line - today they are only flagged, per the keep-never-rewrite rule.
learned.evidence: god6_audit run 10 marks_off_law entries (kcs301-2022, ncs301-2022, bcs301-2026, bcs301-2025-26)
